measurement_boundary.measured_unit: one distinct PMID in the complete sealed 2026 PubMed baseline
measurement_boundary.purpose: construct the exhaustive exact T0 candidate universe and reusable count index before metric selection
not_measured: truth, importance, or novelty of a scientific relationship
absence of academic or non-academic knowledge
a metric score, rank, prediction, or validation result

record_contract.pmid_deduplication: a PMID may occur exactly once across the sealed baseline; any duplicate or missing PMID forces abstention
record_contract.descriptor_identity: UI attribute matching ^D[0-9]{6,9}$ and present in the sealed MeSH descriptor vocabulary
record_contract.descriptor_multiplicity: binary within PMID after exact UI deduplication
record_contract.major_topic_flag: ignored; every assigned descriptor contributes once
record_contract.records_without_mesh: included in the corpus denominator and contribute no descriptor support
record_contract.book_articles: must remain zero in the sealed source manifest; otherwise abstain
record_contract.delete_citations: must remain zero in the sealed source manifest; otherwise abstain

vocabulary_contract.descriptor_order: ascending descriptor UI from the complete sealed descriptor transport
vocabulary_contract.descriptor_classes: all DescriptorRecord classes present in the sealed descriptor transport
vocabulary_contract.tree_numbers: all TreeNumber values attached to a descriptor
vocabulary_contract.ancestor_descendant_rule: exclude when any left tree-number token sequence is a strict prefix of any right sequence or vice versa
vocabulary_contract.term_source: every non-empty ConceptList/Concept/TermList/Term/String value, including preferred terms
vocabulary_contract.term_normalisation: Unicode NFKC, casefold, collapse all whitespace runs to one ASCII space, strip
vocabulary_contract.shared_entry_term_rule: exclude a pair when the normalised term sets intersect

count_contract.corpus_denominator: number of distinct valid PMIDs, required to equal the sealed PubMed record count
count_contract.descriptor_support: number of distinct PMIDs containing the descriptor UI
count_contract.direct_cooccurrence: number of distinct PMIDs containing both unordered descriptor UIs
count_contract.cooccurrence_generation: all unordered combinations of the per-PMID deduplicated descriptor set
count_contract.integer_width: unsigned 64-bit accumulation with explicit overflow guards

candidate_contract.pair_order: left descriptor UI lexicographically less than right descriptor UI
candidate_identity_fields: T0 expected count numerator and denominator

storage_contract.runtime_volume: non-system data volume selected explicitly by the operator

source_file_shard.pair_key: uint64 little-endian: left vocabulary index * 31110 + right vocabulary index
source_file_shard.count: uint32 little-endian exact within-file PMID count
source_file_shard.order: strictly ascending pair key with one row per positive pair
source_file_shard.support_vector: 31110 uint32 little-endian values in vocabulary order

storage_contract.merge: deterministic bounded-fan-in external merge that sums equal pair keys exactly
storage_contract.candidate_stream: ascending uint64 little-endian pair keys after all count and exclusion gates
storage_contract.checkpoint_identity: candidate contract SHA-256 plus sealed source filename and SHA-256

required: all 1334 source file SHA-256 values match the sealed T0 manifest
all per-file parsed record subtotals match the sealed T0 manifest
the global PMID stream contains exactly 39994988 unique values
support and positive-pair counts are exact integer reductions of all source shards
the candidate stream is exhaustive, strictly ordered, duplicate-free, and hash-pinned
every emitted number and binary artifact is traced to this contract and the sealed T0 manifest

output_contract.manifest_write: exclusive create after every completion gate passes
required_hashes: sealed T0 manifest canonical JSON SHA-256
output_contract.claim_boundary: The output is an exact maintained-current PubMed/MeSH count index and candidate set. It is not a metric result, prediction, discovery, validated gap, or evidence of absent knowledge.
